column1: # Where each edition prints Difesa Annesso 2, the register of companies (RNI, art. 3
# L. 185/90): the source pages of DIFESA/A5/2, found by hand (survey of 2026-10-25/26,
# OCR text in Out/ocr/). Years already in a tablesindex (2021-2025) are listed for
# completeness; there the tablesindex row decides.
# volume: the file in In/<year>/. pdf_first, pdf_last: the list pages, PDF indices
#   (1-based). rotated: the PDF pages printed sideways (the reader turns them).
# layer: text (born-digital text layer), ocrlayer (a scan carrying a noisy OCR layer),
# layout: grid (a ruled or columned table: numero, verbale, data verbale, data
#   iscrizione, prot. U.R.N.I., data; cancellations add sede legale, CAP, citta, data
#   iscrizione, motivazione) or list (numbered items: name, register number, date,
#   reason). snapshot: the whole register at year end, not the year's events.
# lists: the lists printed, in page order, with the counts they or the narrative state.
# narrative: the PDF page of the Difesa text on the register (counts; registered at
#   31.12, when printed: a witness for the rebuilt register).
